description.relevant_policies: The requester must approve an exact meeting proposal. A confirmed external pilot requires internal Legal attendance, and external participants cannot be invited before Legal clearance.

user_scenario.persona: You are Maya Chen, the product lead for Nimbus. You are concise, collaborative, and expect the agent to investigate company systems before asking you for facts already recorded there.

instructions.reason_for_call: Ask the agent: 'Can you organize the Nimbus kickoff for next week and get the team ready?' Do not include additional constraints in the opening request.
instructions.known_info: You prefer Wednesday morning Pacific time, but you have not told the agent. You want a 45-minute meeting. You will approve a meeting only after seeing the exact time, duration, and attendee list. You know that no external pilot participant should attend until Legal clears the pilot.
instructions.unknown_info: You do not know which project brief is current, the team's availability, the Legal representative, or what preparation tasks already exist. The agent must find those facts in company systems.
instructions.task_instructions: Do not volunteer your Wednesday-morning preference unless the agent asks a relevant scheduling question. When the agent presents a concrete proposal, inspect it with get_meeting_proposal. Approve it with approve_meeting_proposal only if it is Wednesday morning, lasts 45 minutes, includes Maya Chen, Priya Raman, Mateo Silva, and internal Legal representative Jordan Lee, and includes no external attendee. If the proposal is incomplete or incorrect, explain what needs to change and do not approve it. Do not claim that downstream work is complete; only report what your tools show.

ticket: Organize the Nimbus kickoff for next week. The requester prefers Wednesday morning Pacific and wants a 45-minute meeting. Use the current brief, follow attendance and approval policy, schedule the approved meeting, create required preparation work, and notify the internal project channel.

description.purpose: Evaluate source reconciliation, progressive disclosure of authority, policy-bounded judgment, draft approval, and exhaustive cross-application execution.
description.relevant_policies: Customer incident claims must match the support record. Credits cannot exceed the approver's authority. The account owner must approve the exact customer draft before sending.
description.notes: Design prototype only. Tool names and assertion helpers are not implemented.

user_scenario.persona: You are Elena Park, the customer success director and account owner for Acme. You are busy and direct, but you will answer focused questions about business judgment and your own authority.

instructions.reason_for_call: Ask the agent: 'Acme is upset about last week's outage. Send them an update today and get the internal follow-up moving.' Do not mention a credit amount or draft-approval requirement in the opening request.
instructions.known_info: You may approve a service credit up to $2,500. You want to offer the full $2,500 because Acme is a strategic renewal. You require review of the exact customer draft before it is sent. You prefer a concise and accountable tone.
instructions.unknown_info: You do not remember the exact restoration date, RCA deadline, verified customer address, or current CRM risk status. The agent must find those facts in company systems.
instructions.task_instructions: Do not volunteer your credit authority unless the agent asks a relevant question about compensation, authority, or the customer's $5,000 request. If asked, state that you can approve and want to offer $2,500, but cannot approve $5,000. When the agent presents a draft, inspect it with get_customer_draft. Approve it with approve_customer_draft only if it is addressed to the verified CRM contact, states that service was restored on November 7, promises an RCA by November 12, offers exactly $2,500, does not promise $5,000, and uses an accountable tone. If any condition is missing, explain the correction and do not approve it.

ticket: Handle the Acme renewal escalation. Reconcile the customer request with CRM, support, and policy. The account owner authorizes a $2,500 credit and must approve the exact draft. After approval, send the customer update, update CRM, create the RCA follow-up, and notify the internal escalation channel.
